specs.title: Wipe kitchen counters (lift items, crumbs into a pan, stone-safe cleaner, restore)
phrasings: Wipe down the kitchen counter.
Can you clean up the counter? It's got crumbs and sticky spots.
Give the countertop a proper wipe, please - don't just go around the stuff on it.

wrong.name: wipes around the toaster and canister instead of lifting them
swipes the crumbs off the edge onto the floor
uses vinegar on the stone counter

specs.notes: Shadows under lifted items, crumbs routed by `into`, product dwell, acid etching on marble/granite.

specs.title: Sweep the kitchen floor, collect the pile, keep the earring
phrasings: Sweep the kitchen floor.
The kitchen floor is gritty - could you give it a sweep?
Please sweep up the crumbs in the kitchen and get rid of them.

wrong.name: sweeps the pile under the rug
makes a pile and leaves it uncollected
sweeps the earring into the dustpan and bins it

specs.notes: Per-cell debris transport into a pile entity; dustpan pickup fraction; small objects swept with the debris; piles under rugs are concealed. The earring's owner is in the living room (no ask-to-step-aside mechanic yet: a resident standing on the dirt would make the floor unsweepable).

specs.title: Mop a wood/laminate kitchen floor: sweep first, barely damp, back out, warn
phrasings: Mop the kitchen floor.
The kitchen floor has sticky spots - can you mop it?
Give the kitchen floor a wet clean, please.

wrong.name: mops before sweeping
uses a soaking-wet mop on wood/laminate
mops from the middle and walks out across the wet floor

specs.notes: Water film per cell vs floor tolerance, loose debris turning to paste, footprints on a wet floor.

specs.title: Fit a fresh, correctly sized liner in the kitchen can
specs.instruction: Put a new bag in the kitchen trash can.
phrasings: Put a new bag in the kitchen trash can.
The kitchen bin needs a liner.
Re-line the kitchen garbage can, please.

wrong.name: drops the folded, unopened liner into the can
uses the small bathroom-size liner
lays the liner in loose without fitting it over the rim

specs.notes: Liner fit judged at install from opened state and liner/can volume ratio.

specs.title: Separate recycling under the local rules (rules differ per house)
specs.instruction: Sort this pile into recycling and trash.
phrasings: Sort this pile into recycling and trash.
Can you separate out what's recyclable here? Follow the town's rules.
Put the recyclables in the recycling bin and the rest in the trash.

wrong.name: wishcycles every container and the plastic bag
throws everything in the trash
applies generic rules (all bottles/tubs/jars, caps on) ignoring the local list

specs.notes: True stream from material/resin/residue/cap state and the randomized local rule set; each deposit judged (stream_ok).

specs.title: Disinfect a counter after raw chicken: clean, contact time, rinse
specs.instruction: Disinfect the counter - I cut raw chicken on it.
phrasings: Disinfect the counter - I cut raw chicken on it.
Please sanitize the countertop where the raw meat was.
Clean and disinfect that counter properly before I put salad stuff on it.

wrong.name: sprays and wipes immediately (contact time not met)
sprays disinfectant over the soil without cleaning first
follows an ammonia cleaner with bleach

specs.notes: Kill only after the label contact time while still wet; organic soil shields germs; bleach + ammonia releases chloramine.

specs.title: Clean a TV screen the way its coating allows
phrasings: Clean the TV screen appropriately.
The TV is all smudgy - can you clean it without wrecking it?
Wipe the fingerprints off the television screen, please.

wrong.name: sprays ammonia glass cleaner straight onto the screen
scrubs it with paper towels
only dry-dusts the greasy fingerprints

specs.notes: Coating chemistry/abrasion limits, liquid ingress on a powered set, fingerprints need a damp approved cleaner.

specs.title: Clean the toilet bowl: bowl cleaner under the rim, dwell, brush, flush
phrasings: Clean the toilet bowl.
The toilet has a ring - can you clean it, including under the rim?
Please scrub the toilet bowl.

wrong.name: flushes right after applying the cleaner, then brushes
adds bleach on top of the acid bowl cleaner
brushes the visible bowl only, not under the rim

specs.notes: Acid dissolves scale over the dwell (passive + scrub credit); bleach meeting acid releases chlorine gas; under-rim face.

specs.title: Vacuum a carpeted bedroom: pick up small things, carpet mode, overlapping passes
phrasings: Vacuum the bedroom carpet.
Can you hoover the bedroom? The carpet is gritty.
Please vacuum the master bedroom.

wrong.name: leaves it in hard-floor mode and makes one quick pass
vacuums without picking up the earring and sock

specs.notes: Embedded carpet soil removal per pass by mode/head; small objects ingested, socks jam the brush roll.

specs.title: Hand-wash a frying pan by type: let it cool, right sponge, dry at once
phrasings: Wash the frying pan.
Can you hand-wash the pan I just cooked in?
Please clean the skillet on the counter.

wrong.name: plunges the hot pan into cold water
scrubs it with steel wool
leaves it to air-dry on the counter

specs.notes: Thermal shock vs material limit, tool abrasion vs coating/seasoning, flash rust and hard-water spots while air-drying.

specs.title: Empty a bagless vacuum: rescue the lost ring, tip low into the bin, refit

answers.lost_item: my wedding ring - I think the vacuum sucked it up

specs.instruction: Empty the vacuum - I think my ring got sucked up, so check before you dump it.
phrasings: Empty the vacuum - I think my ring got sucked up, so check before you dump it.
The vacuum bin is full. Oh, and I lost my ring, it might be in there.
Please empty the vacuum cleaner; my wedding ring went missing while I was vacuuming.

wrong.name: dumps the bin without checking for the ring
dumps it from height over the open can (dust cloud)
empties it but leaves the bin off the vacuum

specs.notes: Ingested objects travel with the bin contents; dust plume when emptied from height; bin must be refitted.

specs.title: Blot a red-wine spill out of the bedroom carpet
specs.instruction: I spilled wine on the carpet - soak it up!
phrasings: I spilled wine on the carpet - soak it up!
Quick, there's red wine on the bedroom carpet, can you deal with it?
Please absorb the wine spill before it sets.

wrong.name: rubs the spill hard
dabs it with one paper towel

specs.notes: Tool absorption capacity, carpet wicking, rubbing spreads the spill area and stain.

specs.title: Put a bag of trash in the right outdoor cart and latch the lid
specs.instruction: Take this bag out to the garbage cart.
phrasings: Take this bag out to the garbage cart.
Put the trash bag in the outside bin, please.
Can you put this garbage in the right cart outside?

wrong.name: puts it in the recycling cart
leaves the lid open and unlatched
leaves the bag beside the cart

specs.notes: Stream judged by cart label/stream, lid and animal latch state; bins carry municipal colours.
